title: 大型受け皿付き廃油回収タンク
description: 車両整備の背景に置く車輪付き廃油回収装置。丸い貯留槽と巻き縁、四輪台、押し手、伸縮風の固定支柱・締付つまみ、実際に凹んだ大きな受け皿と粗いワイヤー網・中央口、外部弁と曲線ホース、無数値の不透明レベル表示外形を造形。液体・車両は含まず一式1点。回収・圧力・排出・荷重・安全性能を実装・検証した容器ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.670 × 1.634 × 0.578 m、16,616三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wheeled waste-oil receiver for vehicle-service backgrounds. It has a cylindrical tank/rolled seams, four-caster platform, push handle, fixed telescoping-style riser/locking knob, genuinely recessed large funnel with coarse wire screen/central opening, external valve/curved hose and opaque unnumbered level-indicator exterior. It counts as one assembly and includes no fluid or vehicle. Collection, pressure, discharge, load capacity and safety performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.670 × 1.634 × 0.578 m; 16,616 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
